caption: The drawing depicts a pair of leggings made from buckskin, presented front-facing and side by side. The leggings have a natural, beige coloration with irregular edges, indicating the original texture of the buckskin. Each legging features a distinct vertical panel running down the side, adorned with a geometric beadwork pattern. This pattern consists of alternating blue triangles outlined in red, set within a white background, and bordered by small rectangles in blue at the top and bottom. The lower half of each legging displays a broad, vertical yellow section. At the bottom edges, there is visible fringe made from the same buckskin material. Handwritten notes label the object as "Man's Leggings," mention "Buckskin Paint Dead Dec.," and provide information including "South Western Hill Case #48N." The drawing is signed and dated in the bottom right corner as “Geo. L. Welch Oct. 9, 1935.”
title: Leggings
